title: Dana answers an approver challenge with a bare name, no false identity switch
description: Dana calls about the existing Meridian Supply payment, states the amount, account, and approves within yesterday's close meeting context, then is challenged about the internal approver. She answers 'Marcus Obi.' (bare name) which is the correct answer to the dana_internal_approver knowledge challenge. DEFECT (2026-09-14): before the fix, extractIdentityClaim treated the bare name opening the utterance as a self-identification, recorded a CONTRADICTED identity claim (switching from dana-whitfield to marcus-obi), and the FSM entered RE_ELICIT_AFTER_SWITCH, looping and freezing. FIX: when there's a pending readback for a person-shaped field (approver, counsel, etc), pass answeringPersonQuestion=true to extractIdentityClaim so it skips rule (b) and doesn't treat the bare name as a self-id. Dana's identity remains consistent; before the fix this would freeze with an identity switch, after the fix no false switch occurs. Core fix verified by unit tests in ledger.test.ts and extract.test.ts.
